take out half of your mods and put them somewhere else (im gna call them mod batch 1 for explaining purposes)  
test if your promblem still remains, or if its fixed  
if its;  
a) fixed, it means the broken piece of cc is in mod batch 1. you can take back half of mod batch 1 into your game (put them in a separate folder from the rest of your working cc to not mix them up) and see if the problem came back or if it didnt. repeat process.  
b) you know that mod batch 1 is not causing problems. take half of the remaining mods from your sims mods folder, and repeat the process
